name: Karasuma Chikage
source:
“Can you not meddle with me. I’m not as free as to accompany kids.”

A self-proclaimed novelist who is staying at the Fuurinkan Hotel. He tends to keep to himself and wanders about Okunezato on his own.

His reasoning for visiting Okunezato remains unknown.
